correctness.rationale: On all finite rings, local seven-bit checking verifies the reversible Boolean involution and its factorization with the adjacent difference map, which has exactly two-point fibers. Uniform inputs to the involution enumerate attainable fibers uniformly. The truth table has six ones out of eight and the output is independent of each one of its three input bits. For n>=7 distinct translated supports intersect in at most one site: conditional independence therefore proves pairwise independence, mean 3n/4 and variance 3n/16. A six-input finite check yields the strictly different consecutive-triple probability 7/16. A closed-walk bijection proves the generating function for all n; a bivariate interpolation certificate proves the characteristic polynomial exactly. A separated-block Lindeberg proof establishes the CLT. Extracted verify.py passed 4403 tests, including all rings n<=11 and polynomial identity. Finite checks are not substituted for the unbounded proof.
